next.reason: 1985 VII.4.7.3 SR1: WRITE 'Record-name-1 and identifier-1 must not refer to the same storage area' (a compile-time refusal). 2023 has no such syntax rule: §2023:14.9.51.4 GR5 makes WRITE ... FROM a MOVE to the record followed by WRITE, and its NOTE 1 applies the overlapping-operand and MOVE rules 'to any cases in which the storage area identified by identifier-1 and the record area associated with record-name-1 share any part of their storage areas'; §2023:14.9.51.4 GR9 contemplates identifier-1 being 'one or part of one of the record descriptions'. Under §2023:14.6.10 GR1 the result is undefined unless the items share a data description entry (§2023:14.6.10 GR2). A source 1985 refuses is accepted; no exception condition replaces the refusal.
